title: Tell verifiers to reuse Athena's recorded fmt/clippy/test results
summary: The verifier brief already lists the checks Athena ran, but nothing stops verifiers rerunning the full `cargo test` (often because a "cargo test passes" behavior criterion cites it), which took ~11 min and hit the time limit on 2026-10-18. I read the goal as making the verifier rely on the recorded fmt, clippy and test results for the candidate's SHA and run only targeted tests for new behavior. The audience is Athena's verifiers and the operator who reads their verdicts.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria check that verifiers actually stop rerunning the suite and that a failed recorded check still fails the verdict, not just that text exists.
A briefs.rs test covers the new instruction; cargo test and clippy must be clean.
Fixes the cause (verifiers and readers pushing full-suite reruns) rather than raising the timeout.
Prompt and brief text edits only.
The behavior criterion runs the brief-rendering test.
Independent verifier checks the rendered brief text via tests.
Wording and changelog explain the reason for an outside reader.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Athena already records fmt, clippy and test results for the candidate (the brief section 'Checks Athena ran on this tree'; ci_result::CiRecord and verify::reuse_statement, which only yields text when the SHA matches); the gap is that verifiers are not told to rely on them and criteria still cite `cargo test`.
I could not find a caller of reuse_statement outside verify.rs, so wiring it into the brief is possible but is kept optional (low probability) to keep the change small.
The verifier command allow-list keeps `cargo test` so targeted tests stay possible.
No governance file (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) needs to change.

acceptance_criteria.text: The verifier brief's 'Checks Athena ran on this tree' section tells the verifier that fmt, clippy and test results there are recorded for the candidate and must not be rerun, and that the full `cargo test` suite is not to be rerun.

The verifier prompt (crates/athena-context/prompts/verifier.md, and the change prompt if it conflicts) says to cite the recorded check result for a criterion such as 'cargo test passes', and to run only targeted tests (for example `cargo test -p <crate> <filter>`) to exercise new behavior.

The reader prompt tells readers not to write a behavior criterion that requires rerunning the full suite, fmt or clippy; such outcomes are content criteria satisfied by the recorded checks. Nothing in the change makes a failed or missing recorded check count as passed.
A briefs.rs test renders a verifier brief and asserts the no-rerun instruction appears next to the checks section; running `cargo test -p athena-context` passes.
`cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` are clean, and `cargo test -p athena-context` passes with existing brief snapshot tests updated deliberately.
The change is a focused edit with no secrets or personal data. CHANGELOG.md notes the change and names the 2026-10-18 timeouts as the reason.

out_of_scope: Speeding up or splitting the test suite itself
Changing how or when Athena runs the checks
Letting a verifier reuse results recorded for a different SHA
Changes to the study capability's verifier
departures: Slightly lower cost and time than reference: the change is prompt and brief text plus one test, but a cold cargo test (~11 min) in verification keeps wall time high.
